notes.title: Latest news: Where We've Been and Where We're Going
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41921751/0205cffbd1be33f3b41014b8b2ad6bf0e05e1b4b.png[/img]

[h3][u]The update will arrive in early August! A big surprise is coming for existing O.A.C players in June, and it will be completely free for you! Detailed information will be shared within two weeks.[/u][/h3]


[b]Hello everyone!

Over the past few months, I’ve received a lot of feedback from you—and you’re absolutely right. There haven’t been any updates for a while. As you know, I’m developing O.A.C solo. Unfortunately, I experienced a personal setback due to an accident, which significantly slowed my progress.

That said, I’ve still been moving forward. Thanks to the revenue earned since O.A.C’s launch, I’ve managed to upgrade my development setup. My old system was holding back progress, but now with a new and much faster setup, development is finally gaining serious momentum![/b]

[h3][b] What Happened to the 3 Delayed Updates?[/b][/h3]
You’ll receive all three delayed updates at once in a major release.

[h3][b]Current Progress – Pre-Alpha Almost Complete![/b][/h3]
I’m 85% done with the pre-alpha phase, and the upcoming update will most likely mark the first official alpha release of O.A.C!

[h3][b]What’s Changing Based on Your Feedback?[/b][/h3]
Your feedback made it clear: O.A.C has a strong concept, but it’s also a complex and difficult strategy game. 

[b]To address that:[/b]
[list]
[*] Core mechanics have been simplified
[*] UI and UX have been completely redesigned
[*] Advanced systems are now hidden until they’re actually needed
[*] These improvements will be part of the upcoming update!
[/list]

[h3][b]Why Has Development Been Slow?[/b][/h3]
This isn’t an excuse, but a reminder: I’m working on O.A.C completely solo. This game isn’t driven by financial motives—it’s my dream project. I’ve poured years into it, and I’ll continue doing so to make it the best it can be.

[b] What to Expect in the Alpha Version[/b]

Here’s what’s already included in the current pre-alpha (85% complete):

[list]
[*] 24 country maps
[*] Bureaucracy, world events, diplomacy, military & economy systems
[*] Simplified game interface
[*] Clearer core mechanics
[*] Hidden advanced mechanics (shown only when needed)
[*] Faster game startup times
[*] Full UI/UX overhaul
[*] Save/load bugs fixed
[*] Sound bugs fixed and made user-configurable
[/list]


[h3][b]Music Album & DLC Promise[/b][/h3]
The complete O.A.C soundtrack is ready and will be completely free for all players who own the game.

As I’ve promised from the beginning: All O.A.C DLCs will always be free now and in the future!


[h2][b]A Small Hint for Our Players…[/b][/h2]

[h3]We also have something special on the way — a completely free surprise for all O.A.C players. It's not just content — it's something crafted with passion for our dedicated community. Stay tuned, a separate announcement is coming soon... [/h3]


[h3][b]Final Words[/b][/h3]
Thank you for your patience, your feedback, and your belief in the project. I’m here, working hard every day and with your continued support, O.A.C will become something truly special.

Much love!
V.B.B - [C.O.T.E]
www.cotestudios.com

notes.title: About the upcoming March 15 update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41921751/a14a22868865610c8ff1af1c9a40a42a183d81f6.png[/img]

[b]The list below will be with you in the March 15 update, I am working steadily on these and more.[/b]


Greetings to all O.A.C Players!

O.A.C is completing the 1st month of its first alpha version released as of March 2.

[b][i]As you know, you will receive our regular updates on the 15th of every month and our major updates every 3 months. 

Also, bug fixes may arrive at any time and date.[/i][/b]

____
[b]Some Innovations You Will See in the March 15 Update.[/b]

- Opening of +5 new countries for testing (Poland, Brazil, France, Bulgaria, Italy and Georgia)

- Completion of lists of all political parties, statesmen and city bureaucracies in countries currently open to testing (7 countries in total) Correction of errors and data upload deficiencies that you have noticed and reported to me will be completed in all these countries.

With this update, a total of 13 countries will be active in O.A.C, including the previous ones.

- The error in completing "Beginning Missions", which is now called "Starter Quests" will be fixed.

- Fixed the location of the capital house in Greece. Fixed the bug that appeared in a different city.

- New bug fixes have been made on the map.

- The Tech Shop user interface has been reviewed and transformed from its simple form to a new interface. (UI updates will continue and will be gradually improved with each update)

- Healing mechanics of Brain Anomalies

- Starting a business - The mechanics of Starting a Company continue to be developed. New investment instruments are being worked on.

- The game's tutorial continues to be improved and made more comprehensive.

- Work continues on the "time accelerator" in the game. Although it will not be available for testing in the March 15 update, you will now be able to increase and speed up the game time by 2x - 3x -5x in the next update. However, keep in mind that this will affect your character's "time perception" and cause some brain anomalies.

- New features will be added to the character creation screen.

- Your character's choice of religion will now affect your gaming experience and the public's attitude towards you.

- Interacting with the team employees you are hiring.

- Interacting with your tenants (evacuation, rental agreement updates, etc.)

- Fixing errors in the Save and Load system (Please note that your game saves will be deleted many times until Steam integrates into the cloud saves system. I'm sorry for this problem, but we have to experience these problems for now.)

- Enabling the Settings Tab on the Start Screen will be active.

________
[b]The above list will be with you in the March 15 update, I am working steadily on these and more.[/b]

[b]Thank you so much for being with me![/b]

[b]Best Regars![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41921751/a14a22868865610c8ff1af1c9a40a42a183d81f6.png[/img]

notes.title: Bug fixes after February 16 Regular Update | #2
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I could not share an informative post after the February 16 Update.

However, you will soon receive a detailed post about all the changes and the process.

I work non-stop almost every hour and strive to make it better. Your support will increase this speed and make me more motivated. Thank you so much for doing this!

[b]Some of the bug fixes you reported;[/b]

[b]+[/b] UI bugs detected and resolved as a result of your feedback.

[b]+[/b] Observed bugs of 7 countries open to testing have been fixed.

[b]+ [/b]Minor economy fixes made

[b]+[/b] "Mobile Phone" has been added to the communication tools.

[b]+[/b] City tests were carried out in the USA, UK, Germany and Turkey, Greece and Azerbaijan. Simple errors detected were fixed.

[b]+[/b] Added Save/Load system (It may not seem to be fully working yet, but the saves you make are functional.) You may need to clear your progress several times until the Save/Load system is fully integrated. I will inform you about this.

[b]+[/b] Errors on the country selection screen have been completely resolved.

[b]+[/b] Technology shops are now accessible in cities. This was for testing purposes and other buildings will be fully active in the March 15 update.

[b]+[/b] Fixed data loading error in President of the United States / U.K details. We experienced the same problem in political parties and this was also solved. We also experienced this problem in the character brain. I am aware of the data upload error experienced in some countries that have recently opened for testing, the definitive solution to this will come in the March 15 Update.

[b]+[/b] All building icons have been updated in the right panel "Buildings" tab. In all other tabs, innovations and bug fixes will continue with each update.

You know, I'm still in my infancy, but keep working non-stop! I will give you my best.

Regards!

notes.title: (POSTPONED TO 16 FEBRUARY) February 15 Future Updates
notes.content:
[h1][b]Attention: This update has been postponed to 1 day later.[/b][/h1]


[b]What's new you'll see in the update on February 15th[/b]

[b]+[/b] Simple in-game tutorials will be added.

[b]+[/b] 5 more countries open to testing (United States of America, United Kingdom, Germany, Bulgaria, Azerbaijan)

[b]+[/b] Opening communication tools to testing (Mobile phones and computers)

[b]+[/b] Save / Load System

[b]+[/b] Some bug fixes on the map

[b]+[/b] Elimination of bugs in country information opened for testing (Total 7 countries)

[b]+[/b] Correcting Economic Imbalances

[b]+[/b] Activation of your character's team create process.

[b]+[/b] Fixing detected and reported UI panel closing bugs.

[b]-[/b] (Skirmish Mode) Preparation for direct government management update [u](It won't be playable yet)[/u]


[b]Update Details[/b]

This upcoming update has been made by adding the data obtained together with the feedback of all our players + O.A.C's normal development plan.

 [b] (?) Simple in-game tutorials will be added.[/b]
Our players reported that O.A.C's challenging mechanics needed to be supported by an in-game tutorial. For this reason, we added a tutorial within the game. 

It will continue to be developed continuously.


[b](?) 5 more countries open to testing (United States of America, United Kingdom, Germany, Bulgaria, Azerbaijan)[/b]

5 Opening the new country to testing, activating country bureaucrats, city and city information, economy and regime models. 

Countries with states (such as the U.S.A.) will be detailed into the state system and cities and even counties in future updates. For now, in countries with a state system, you will only progress through states.


[b](?) Opening communication tools to testing (Mobile phones and computers)[/b]

Your character can now access communication tools in the world. In the "COMMUNICATION" tab.
In the first place, these are mobile phones and computers. 

Although the features are limited at this stage, they will be improved gradually.


[b](?) Save / Load System[/b]

We know the inconvenience of not being able to save your game and character for 15 days. The reason for this was the temporal disruptions in saving the huge data contained in O.A.C. And this problem is solved. Now you can save your character and game time! 


[b](?) Some bug fixes on the map[/b]

As a result of the feedback of our first players, the city location information in the countries in the test was corrected.

Our future update plans (in the coming months) include working to make country cities, regions and states increasingly more detailed.

Also, as we always say, 5 new countries will continue to be opened for testing in each update!


[b](?) Elimination of bugs in country information opened for testing (Total 7 countries)[/b]

As a result of the feedback of our first players, the country information errors in the test have been largely eliminated.


[b](?) Correcting Economic Imbalances[/b]

Although the corrections will become more obvious and affect the mechanics during the period when country relations are active, minor errors in economic balances have been corrected.


[b](?) Fixing detected and reported UI panel closing bugs.[/b] 

The error reported to us that some UI windows could not be closed has been fixed.


[b](?) Activation of your character's team create process.[/b]

Your character's "COMMUNITY" tab is now active.

You can hire people from all professions and include them in your team. Remember that your team will play a big role in the "internal uprising / coup" mechanic that will be opened soon!

**The above update will be available starting February 15**

[b](?) (Focused Skirmish Mode) Preparation for direct government management update [u](It won't be playable yet)[/u] [/b] 

Warning: Not playable yet!
Although the mode will not be available for playtesting in this update yet, we can offer you a partial demo. For a short-term demo of the skirmish mode, you can wait for the first March update.


Regards!

notes.title: First Player Privileges | Mid-month update and Discounted Price End Information
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41921751/0205cffbd1be33f3b41014b8b2ad6bf0e05e1b4b.png[/img]

Hello everyone! 

Especially to the first O.A.C Players! This announcement will be for you.

As of today, O.A.C has completed its 1-week release life. Thank you to all the gamers around the world who own and care about this baby in its infancy!

The O.A.C got a lot more attention than I expected, and you loved it in its flawed way. Thank you a thousand times for all your motivational words and support. I have bigger responsibilities now! 

We are still at the very beginning of everything and we will work even harder for the best.

Now I will work harder and give you the best.


[b]SOME PRIVILEGES FOR O.A.C'S FIRST PLAYERS[/b]

All these rights will be valid for life.

I will make my first supporters who set out with me on a very long journey extra happy throughout the entire process. 

For example, my future plans for O.A.C include creating physical and collectible products. I will ship all these products to the first players of O.A.C completely free of charge. 

When the most perfect and complete version of the game is released, we will send physical O.A.C products with official banderol. And like everything else, it's completely free. 

Including the boxed, collectible and original DVD of O.A.C.

All DLC and extra official mods created for O.A.C will be completely free for the first players of O.A.C.

As C.O.T.E Technology & Software Development Company, we will give VIP membership rights on our official website for all new games / products or services we will create. (Forever)

As a result of these rights, they will benefit from the products / publications / training or services that our studio will offer to the public today or in the future with extra privileges.

We are also preparing a C.O.T.E VIP card for you. Keep this card!


[b]INFORMATION ABOUT ROUTINE UPDATE DATES[/b]

As we mentioned before, O.A.C will receive minor updates on the 15th of each month and major updates every 3 months. Also, hotfix may come at any time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41921751/0205cffbd1be33f3b41014b8b2ad6bf0e05e1b4b.png[/img]

[b]END OF DISCOUNTED PRICE[/b]

As stated in the early access announcement, price increases may be observed as the O.A.C development level increases.

We guarantee to deliver a gaming experience that matches the value of purchases in the future.

Once the discount ends, the right to take part in "First Player Privileges" will also end for new players.

This date is the moment when February 9, 2024 ends and February 10, 2024 begins.

Best regards!

[h1][b]Some News[/b][/h1]

[b]Hello to all gamers who follow me from all over the world!

The long-running pre-alpha version is now complete! It is now in an Alpha release and waiting to meet its first players.

The official release date will be announced in just a few days.

You'll also be able to see updated screenshots of O.A.C with new UI designs on our Steam Store.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41921751/0205cffbd1be33f3b41014b8b2ad6bf0e05e1b4b.png[/img]

For a very long time, I have focused on the coding, story, art design, music of our game, determination of special forces for countries and map drawings, as well as the design of units, events and game mechanics.

Additionally, O.A.C actually contains a giant world and a huge data warehouse. This massive data warehouse had to be partially compatible with thousands of rows of "real world" data. It took me a lot of time to research all of this, collect it, verify its accuracy, process it and integrate it into a O.A.C game.

A must for a grand strategy!

I didn't pay enough attention to the UI throughout this entire process, and a simple UI was enough to sustain the pre-alpha mechanics throughout all testing phases.

But now is the time! And I made my first presentable design for the UI.

While I tested that the UX was good, I made our first update on the UI.

I wanted to share the latest version with you. 

A few small examples from the latest version;

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41921751/36739e9543bd334ff4101298ca830b2acda0bbab.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]I am sharing some other UI examples in the O.A.C for you. 

[i]Don't care about statistical data/descriptions in UI images. I chopped the salads, but I wanted to send you some visuals before putting them on the plate. The kitchen part of the job is always really complicated! [/i]

(You can enlarge the thumbnails by clicking on them.) [/b][/h3]

You can find the new images on our store page, in the O.A.C's promotional gallery.

notes.title: About Major Update, Fixes, Regular Updates and Languages
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The final test update for early access was released yesterday in closed alpha.

Now until the release date, all the features in Early Access will be analyzed, playability, potential bugs detection and bug fixes. Before early access, a test version with as few or completely bug-free as possible will be available for you.

[b]WHAT WILL HAPPEN AFTER THAT?[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41921751/ab81eeaad85c2696e201e1f0fe0c28dd9b534f0b.gif[/img]
[olist]
[*] You will now receive regular updates on the 1st of each month as of the day the O.A.C will be released worldwide.
[*] As of the first week of each month, you will receive bug fixes as a result of players' feedback.
[*] You will get major updates every 4 months. (3 times a year)
[*] You will not pay for any DLC that will be developed forever.

[*]All ideas, suggestions and requests will be considered. This is a limitless world.

notes.title: We will be with you very soon!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41921751/01e1b798e2553ca9299baee1291f5c90ff433699.png[/img]


[previewyoutube=5CGjpb8rP0g;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Hello World![/b]

[b]OAC will be released January 2023![/b]

It meets you at the end of the coding process that has been going on for more than 2 years. I must say to anyone who will buy our game, 

It was not easy on my own. But no problem!

These are the conditions for now. One day I will create my own team, I want this very much. Since the game is a pre-alpha version, I must say that we have many years ahead of us to say that it is over. It is like a life. This is the work of a great effort and this effort will never end.

All possible bugs will be fixed as quickly as possible with each update.

Many features will be disabled "for a short time" when you purchase the game. But with regular updates and hard work, I'm ready to do the best!

Most importantly, I will never release a "paid DLC". All future features are yours when you buy the game. I promise.

I work 18 hours a day. I only rest 1 day a week. It means I sacrificed myself to create a great game. And I never give up. I want to involve you in the development process because I am alone. And now I want to grow up with you.
I'm open to any good advice and criticism you can give me. I don't have an advertising budget, nor do I have familiar publisher friends. Just you and our dreams.
Don't forget to join[url=https://steamcommunity.com/groups/coteofficial] our community[/url] and email me.

(Best support, Wish List or Purchase)
Every support you give will motivate me even more and we will grow together.

Developments continue at full speed! I will publish a guide very soon.

The content of the guide will also include where I was in the O.A.C development process, as well as in-game mechanics and detail images.

I will also post an intro + gameplay video.

[u]There may be short delays as I am alone, so I apologize in advance.[/u]

As you know, we are not a known game production company yet. We don't make a known game either. Basically, debuting with a "trendy game/hyper casual" without taking any risks would be preferring our dreams and goals to money. That's why we put our dreams and the dreams of the players above everything else by making our first game a giant strategy game with great risks.

Being with us on this path will be a factor that makes us owe you a big thank you.

In return, we will provide you with an excellent strategy experience.

Have fun already!
Stay healthy.

[b]THINGS YOU SHOULD KNOW BEFORE BUYING[/b]
[list]
[*] You are purchasing a pre-alpha version.
[*] You will not pay for future updates, additional DLC packs or innovations. It will be developed for free forever.
[*] Postponing Turkish language support to a later date. (There will be no Turkish language support at the time of publication)
[*] The pre-alpha release is expected to last up to 1 year. And then the alpha phase will begin.
[*] You will receive regular updates on the first day of each month.
[*] You will receive directly bug fixes in the middle of each month.
[*] Included content: Getting Started Guide
[*] Achievements
[*] If you don't have the purchasing power yet and want to support me, adding it to the wish list will motivate me.
[/list]

[b]Thank you![/b]
